idea-plugin.name: XSD Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Go-to-definition and a real structure tree for XSD/WSDL schemas split across multiple files — resolved through <xs:include>/<xs:import>/ <xs:redefine>, entirely against local files.

Built from real evidence in JetBrains Marketplace reviews of a paid XSD/WSDL visualizer plugin (~$10/month, 69% of reviews at 3 stars or fewer): "not recognizing correlations between multiple xsd files in same folder", "I need to visualize complex wsdl (xsd was splitted to more files) and this was not able to parse it", and "not optimized at all on big WSDL files as it is REALLY slow."

Ctrl+Click (or Ctrl+B) on any schemaLocation value navigates straight to the referenced file — unresolved locations are flagged inline. The "XSD Structure" tool window follows the active editor and shows every element/complexType/simpleType/ attributeGroup/group declared across the whole include/import graph, not just the one file currently open.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no network access — an http(s):// schemaLocation is never fetched, only ever shown as unresolved.
